name: LODESTAR
protocol_measure: SubT-MRS Long Corridor replay: absolute pose error (APE). Desktop computation averaged across benchmark recordings.
result: APE 1.386 m versus 3.113 m for FAST-LIO2; benchmark-average computation 28.69 versus 21.04 ms.
interpretation: Selective anchoring and point selection improve this sequence at additional computation cost; no LiDAR-blackout or closed-loop test.

name: FIT-SLAM 2
protocol_measure: Exploration with simulator poses and common control; completion time, plus Fisher-information timing analysis.
result: Cave: 880 versus 1118 s for FAEL; Corridor: 1809 versus 1706 s. Planning: 20.8 ms without and 63.0 ms with Fisher information.
interpretation: The ordering changes with the scene. Planner benchmarks and the SLAM/localizability ablation answer different questions.

name: Safe Horizon MPC
protocol_measure: 100 Gaussian eight-pedestrian simulations; common solver/cost and matched joint-risk specification 0.05; duration mean (SD).
result: 16.0 (1.9) s versus 18.4 (2.4) s for CC-MPC. Maximum estimated plan collision probabilities: 0.0092 versus 0.0019.
interpretation: Faster traversal accompanies less conservative plan risk under a known motion distribution; these are not empirical mission collision rates.

name: LeLaN
protocol_measure: Visible-target navigation: 150 trials, 28 objects, success within 0.2 m; separate 15-trial obstacle ablation.
result: Goal success 0.89 versus 0.67 for OWL-v2 + ZoeDepth. With obstacles: arrival 0.60 with versus 0.13 without collision training.
interpretation: Target arrival and obstacle handling are separate evaluations; visible-target success does not establish open-world search or a collision-risk bound.

name: TAPM-IVP
protocol_measure: Scene 1 simulation; two robots, ten independent trials per method, common local planner/tracker.
result: Success 90% for each robot versus 40% and 30% in the two-robot ablation without partitioning and greedy subgoal selection.
interpretation: The ablation supports the combined design, not either module alone. Rates are per robot; hardware demonstrations use two Ackermann vehicles.

name: GP-based recovery
protocol_measure: Ten simulated runs per goal/world; same planner with and without recovery. Counts read from the plotted rates.
result: Dense 1 m doorways, goal 0: 8/10 versus 3/10 successes. Sparse 2 m doorways, goal 0: 10/10 for both.
interpretation: Recovery benefit depends on the failure setting. The physical demonstrations do not provide a comparable success-rate estimate.

name: Home deployment
protocol_measure: Ten-home field deployment; three assistive-service types, including requested but unperformed interventions.
result: 1130 successful, 177 failed, and 232 unperformed interventions out of 1539 requests. Reported success: 86.46% of 1307 attempts.
interpretation: The success denominator excludes unperformed requests; availability and assistance conditions remain relevant to service-level interpretation.
